130 template <typename T>
131 __host__ __device__ T binary_search(const T *arr, const T lt, const T rt, const T searchVal, bool &found)
132 {
133 T left = lt, right = rt;
134 found = false;
135 while (left < right)
136 {
137 const T mid = (left + right) / 2;
138 T val = arr[mid];
139 if (val == searchVal)
140 {
141 found = true;
142 return mid;
143 }
144 bool pred = val < searchVal;
145 if (pred)
146 {
147 left = mid + 1;
148 }
149 else
150 {
151 right = mid;
152 }
153 }
154 return left;
155 }

158 template <typename T, uint CPARTSIZE = 32>
159 __device__ __forceinline__ uint64 warp_sorted_count_and_encode_full(
160 const T *const A, const size_t aSz, T *B,
161 T bSz, T j, T num_divs_local, T *encode)
162 {
163 const int _warpIdx = threadIdx.x / CPARTSIZE; // which warp in thread block
164 const int _laneIdx = threadIdx.x % CPARTSIZE; // which thread in warp
165 // cover entirety of A with warp
166 for (T i = _laneIdx; i < aSz; i += CPARTSIZE)
167 {
168 const T searchVal = A[i];
169 bool found = false;
170 const T lb = graph::binary_search<T>(B, 0, bSz, searchVal, found);
171 if (found)
172 {
173 ////////////////////////////// Device function ///////////////////////
174 T chunk_index = i / 32; // 32 here is the division size of the encode
175 T inChunkIndex = i % 32;
176 atomicOr(&encode[j * num_divs_local + chunk_index], 1 << inChunkIndex);
177
178 T chunk_index1 = j / 32; // 32 here is the division size of the encode
179 T inChunkIndex1 = j % 32;
180 atomicOr(&encode[i * num_divs_local + chunk_index1], 1 << inChunkIndex1);
181 /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
182 }
183 }
184 return 0;
185 }

245__device__ __forceinline__ void wait_for_donor(
246 cuda::atomic<uint32_t, cuda::thread_scope_device> &work_ready, uint32_t &shared_state,
247 queue_callee(queue, tickets, head, tail))
248{
249 uint32_t ns = 8;
250 do
251 {
252 if (work_ready.load(cuda::memory_order_relaxed))
253 {
254
255 if (work_ready.load(cuda::memory_order_acquire))
256 {
257 shared_state = 2;
258 work_ready.store(0, cuda::memory_order_relaxed);
259 break;
260 }
261 }
262 else if (queue_full(queue, tickets, head, tail, CB))
263 {
264 shared_state = 100;
265 break;
266 }
267 } while (ns = my_sleep(ns));
268}

295__device__ __forceinline__ void wait_for_donor_warp_(
296 cuda::atomic<uint32_t, cuda::thread_scope_device> &work_ready, uint32_t &block_shared_state, uint32_t &warp_shared_state,
297 queue_callee(queue, tickets, head, tail))

322template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
323__device__ __forceinline__ void setup_stack_first_level_psanse(
324 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh)
325{
326 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
327 {
328 sh.src = sh.i; // Gets the vertex
329 sh.srcStart = gh.gsplit.splitPtr[sh.src]; // Gets the start index of the second part on the column index array
330 sh.srcLen = gh.gsplit.rowPtr[sh.src + 1] - sh.srcStart; // Gets the length of the second part of the neighbourhood
331 sh.usrcStart = gh.gsplit.rowPtr[sh.src]; // Gets the start index on the first part of the column index array
332 sh.usrcLen = gh.gsplit.splitPtr[sh.src] - sh.usrcStart; // Get the length of the first part of the neighbourhood
333
334 sh.num_divs_local = ((sh.usrcLen) + 32 - 1) / 32; // For excess the numbers of register to contein the neighbourhood of the chosen vertex
335 auto encode_offset = sh.sm_block_id * (MAXDEG * NUMDIVS);
336 sh.encode = &gh.encoded_induced_subgraph[encode_offset];
337
338 auto level_offset = sh.sm_block_id * NUMDIVS * (MAXLEVEL);
339 sh.pl = &gh.P[level_offset];
340 sh.bl = &gh.B[level_offset];
341 sh.al = &gh.A[level_offset];
342
343 size_t Xx_offset = sh.sm_block_id * MAXDEG;
344 sh.Xx_aux_shared = &gh.Xx_aux[Xx_offset];
345 sh.current_bucket = &gh.current[Xx_offset];
346 sh.next_bucket = &gh.next[Xx_offset];
347 sh.ordering = &gh.ordering[Xx_offset];
348
349 size_t clique_offset = sh.sm_block_id * MAXLEVEL;
350 if (gh.eval) sh.c = &gh.C[clique_offset];
351
352 auto level_item_offset = sh.sm_block_id * (MAXLEVEL);
353 sh.level_pointer_index = &gh.level_pointer[level_item_offset];
354 sh.colored = &gh.colored[level_item_offset];
355
356 sh.level_pointer_index[0] = 0;
357 sh.l = sh.base_l = 2;
358
359 sh.colored[current_level] = false;
360
361 sh.lastMask_i = (sh.usrcLen) >> 5;
362 sh.lastMask_ii = (1 << ((sh.usrcLen) & 0x1F)) - 1; // Takes the last 5 bit so multiple of 32
363 }
364 __syncthreads();
365
366}

542template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
543__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_kcore_first_level(
544 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
545 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
546 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, const T& num_divs_local, const T const* encode, const T& max_clq)
547{
548
549 __shared__ int cur_core, min_degree, todos, ordering_sz;
550 __shared__ int currents;
551 auto &g = gh.gsplit;
552
553 first_thread_block
554 {
555 min_degree = sh.usrcLen;
556 todos = sh.usrcLen;
557 sh.current_bucket_sz = 0;
558 sh.next_bucket_sz = 0;
559 ordering_sz = 0;
560 }
561 __syncthreads();
562
563 // Computes the degrees and get the min
564 for (T j = lh.wx; j < sh.usrcLen; j += lh.numPartitions)
565 {
566 T _degree = 0;
567 for (T k = lh.lx; k < num_divs_local; k += CPARTSIZE)
568 {
569 _degree += __popc(encode[j * num_divs_local + k]);
570 }
571
572 __syncwarp();
573
574 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, _degree);
575
576 __syncwarp();
577
578 if (lh.lx == 0)
579 {
580 sh.degree[j] = _degree;
581 atomicMin(&min_degree, _degree);
582 }
583
584 __syncwarp();
585 }
586
587 __syncthreads();
588
589 fetch(cur_core, min_degree);
590
591 __syncthreads();
592
593
594 while (todos > 0)
595 {
596
597 fetch_both(sh.current_bucket_sz, 0, sh.next_bucket_sz, 0);
598
599 __syncthreads();
600
601 // Filter the min degrees vertices
602 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.usrcLen; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
603 if (sh.degree[j] == cur_core)
604 sh.current_bucket[atomicAdd(&sh.current_bucket_sz, 1)] = j;
605
606 __syncthreads();
607
608 fetch(currents, sh.current_bucket_sz);
609
610 __syncthreads();
611
612 while (currents > 0)
613 {
614
615 first_thread_block
616 {
617 todos -= currents;
618 sh.next_bucket_sz = 0;
619 }
620
621 __syncthreads();
622
623 // For each candidate inside the bucket
624 for (T j = lh.wx; j < sh.current_bucket_sz; j += lh.numPartitions)
625 {
626 const T node = sh.current_bucket[j];
627
628 if (lh.lx == 0 && cur_core + 1 >= max_clq) {
629 sh.ordering[atomicAdd(&ordering_sz, 1)] = g.colInd[sh.usrcStart + node];
630 }
631 __syncwarp();
632
633 for (T k = lh.lx; k < sh.usrcLen; k += CPARTSIZE)
634 {
635 if (encode[node * num_divs_local + (k >> 5)] & (1 << (k & 0x1F)))
636 {
637 const T neighbour = k;
638 if (sh.degree[neighbour] > cur_core)
639 {
640 T old = atomicSub(&sh.degree[neighbour], 1);
641 if (old - 1 == cur_core)
642 sh.next_bucket[atomicAdd(&sh.next_bucket_sz, 1)] = neighbour;
643 }
644 }
645 }
646 __syncwarp();
647 }
648
649 __syncthreads();
650
651 // Swap current with next
652 first_thread_block
653 {
654 T* tmp_ptr = sh.current_bucket;
655 sh.current_bucket = sh.next_bucket;
656 sh.next_bucket = tmp_ptr;
657
658 T tmp = sh.current_bucket_sz;
659 sh.current_bucket_sz = sh.next_bucket_sz;
660 sh.next_bucket_sz = tmp;
661
662 currents = sh.current_bucket_sz;
663 }
664
665 __syncthreads();
666
667 }
668
669 first_thread_block
670 cur_core++;
671
672 __syncthreads();
673
674 }
675
676 fetch_both(sh.usrcLen, ordering_sz, sh.max_core_l1, cur_core - 1);
677 __syncthreads();
678
679}
680
681template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
682__device__ __forceinline__ void reverse_degeneracy_ordering_first_level(
683 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
684 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
685 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh)
686{
687 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.usrcLen / 2; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
688 {
689 T tmp = sh.ordering[j];
690 sh.ordering[j] = sh.ordering[sh.usrcLen - j - 1];
691 sh.ordering[sh.usrcLen - j - 1] = tmp;
692
693 // tmp = sh.cores[j];
694 // sh.cores[j] = sh.cores[sh.usrcLen - j - 1];
695 // sh.cores[sh.usrcLen - j - 1] = tmp;
696 }
697
698 __syncthreads();
699}

702template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
703__device__ __forceinline__ void encode_clear(
704 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh, SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> & sh, const T &lim)
705{
706 for (T j = lh.wx; j < lim; j += lh.numPartitions)
707 for (T k = lh.lx; k < sh.num_divs_local; k += CPARTSIZE)
708 sh.encode[j * sh.num_divs_local + k] = 0x00;
709 __syncthreads();
710}

724template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
725__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_P_intersection_to_first_level(
726 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
727 const T& usrcLen, const T num_divs_local, T* cur_pl)
728{
729

731 {
732 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
733 cur_pl[j] = m;
734 }
735
736 __syncthreads();
737
738}

752template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
753__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_P_intersection_for_next_level(
754 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
755 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const T& num_divs_local,
756 const T const* cur_bl, const T const* cur_al, T* cur_pl)
757{
758
759 const T prevCand = lh.newIndex;
760 const T prevCandBlock = prevCand >> 5;
761 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += blockDim.x)
762 {
763 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
764 const T t = sh.encode[lh.newIndex * num_divs_local + j];
765 const T prevCandMask = (j > prevCandBlock) ? 0x00000000 :
766 ((j < prevCandBlock) ? 0xFFFFFFFF : ((1 << (prevCand & 0x1F)) - 1));
767 const T bua = (cur_bl[j] & prevCandMask) | cur_al[j];
768 const T tbua = bua & m & t;
769 cur_pl[j] = tbua;
770 }
771
772 __syncthreads();
773}

824template <bool WL, typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
825__device__ __forceinline__ void get_candidates_for_next_level(
826 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
827 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const T &level,
828 const T const* cur_bl)
829{
830
831 __syncthreads();
832 const T nextCand = sh.level_pointer_index[level];
833 const T nextCandBlock = nextCand >> 5;
834 for (T j = threadIdx.x + nextCandBlock; j < sh.num_divs_local; j += blockDim.x)
835 {
836 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
837 const T nextCandMask = (j > nextCandBlock) ? 0xFFFFFFFF : (~((1 << (nextCand & 0x1F)) - 1));
838 T nodes = cur_bl[j] & nextCandMask & m;
839 if (WL)
840 {
841 T idx = 0;
842 while ((idx = __ffs(nodes)))
843 {
844 --idx;
845 // Conversion from bitset to Vertex Ivdex
846 const T donate_index = j * 32 + idx;
847 sh.Xx_aux_shared[atomicAdd(&sh.Xx_aux_sz, 1)] = donate_index;
848 nodes ^= 1u << idx;
849 }
850 }
851
852 }
853
854 __syncthreads();
855}

891template <bool WL, typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
892__device__ __forceinline__ void get_warp_candidates_for_next_level_local(
893 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
894 WARP_SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &wsh, const T &level,

899 {

902 for (T j = nextCandBlock; j < wsh.num_divs_local && wsh.Xx_aux_sz < NUMPART - 1; j++)
903 {
904 const T m = (j == wsh.lastMask_i) ? wsh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
905 const T nextCandMask = (j > nextCandBlock) ? 0xFFFFFFFF : (~((1 << (nextCand & 0x1F)) - 1));
906 T nodes = cur_bl[j] & nextCandMask & m;
907 if (WL)
908 {
909 T idx = 0;
910 while ((idx = __ffs(nodes)) && wsh.Xx_aux_sz < NUMPART - 1)
911 {
912 --idx;
913 // Conversion from bitset to Vertex Ivdex
914 const T donate_index = j * 32 + idx;
915 wsh.Xx_aux_shared[wsh.Xx_aux_sz++] = donate_index;
916 nodes ^= 1u << idx;
917 }
918 }
919 }
920 }
921
922 __syncwarp();

927template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
928__device__ __forceinline__ void do_fork(
929 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
930 const T & num_divs_local,
931 const T const* cur_bl, const T const* cur_al,
932 queue_callee(queue, tickets, head, tail))
933{
934 // Donated vertex stays un Xx_aux_shared
935 for (T j = 0; j < sh.Xx_aux_sz; j++)
936 {
937 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
938 queue_wait_ticket(queue, tickets, head, tail, CB, sh.worker_pos, sh.shared_other_sm_block_id);
939 __syncthreads();
940
941 const uint32_t other_sm_block_id = sh.shared_other_sm_block_id;
942 const auto other_level_offset = other_sm_block_id * NUMDIVS * (MAXLEVEL);
943 const auto other_clique_offset = other_sm_block_id * (MAXLEVEL);
944 T *other_pl = &gh.P[other_level_offset];
945
946 if (gh.eval)
947 {
948 T *other_c = &gh.C[other_clique_offset];
949
950 for (T k = threadIdx.x; k < sh.l - 1; k += blockDim.x)
951 other_c[k] = sh.c[k];
952
953 __syncthreads();
954
955 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
956 other_c[sh.l - 1] = sh.ordering[sh.Xx_aux_shared[j]];
957 }
958
959 __syncthreads();
960
961 const T prevCand = sh.Xx_aux_shared[j];
962 const T prevCandBlock = prevCand >> 5;
963 for (T k = threadIdx.x; k < num_divs_local; k += blockDim.x)
964 {
965 const T m = (k == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
966 const T t = sh.encode[sh.Xx_aux_shared[j] * sh.num_divs_local + k];
967 const T prevCandMask = (k > prevCandBlock) ? 0x00000000 : (k < prevCandBlock ? 0xFFFFFFFF : ((1 << (prevCand & 0x1F)) - 1));
968 const T bua = (cur_bl[k] & prevCandMask) | cur_al[k];
969 const T tbua = bua & t & m;
970 other_pl[(next_level) * num_divs_local + k] = tbua;
971 }
972
973 __syncthreads();
974
975 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
976 {
977 uint32_t *message = &gh.global_message[other_sm_block_id * MSGCNT];
978 sh.level_pointer_index[current_level] = max(sh.level_pointer_index[current_level], sh.Xx_aux_shared[j] + 1);
979 message[0] = sh.root_sm_block_id;
980 message[1] = sh.l + 1;
981 message[2] = sh.srcLen;
982 message[3] = sh.usrcLen;
983 message[4] = sh.i;
984 gh.work_ready[other_sm_block_id].store(1, cuda::memory_order_release);
985 sh.worker_pos++;
986 }
987 __syncthreads();
988 }
989
990 __syncthreads();
991}

1034 message[0] = wsh.root_sm_warp_id;
1035 message[1] = wsh.l + 1;
1036 message[2] = wsh.root_sm_block_id;
1037 message[3] = wsh.usrcLen;
1038 message[4] = wsh.i;
1039 gh.work_ready[other_sm_warp_id].store(1, cuda::memory_order_release);

1153template<typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1154__device__ __forceinline__ void shared_wait_for_donor_warp_local(
1155 cuda::atomic<uint32_t, cuda::thread_scope_device> &work_ready, uint32_t &warp_shared_state,
1156 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh)
1157{
1158 uint32_t ns = 8;
1159 do
1160 {
1161 if (work_ready.load(cuda::memory_order_relaxed))
1162 {
1163
1164 if (work_ready.load(cuda::memory_order_acquire))
1165 {
1166 warp_shared_state = 2;
1167 work_ready.store(0, cuda::memory_order_relaxed);
1168 break;
1169 }
1170 }
1171 else if (shared_queue_full(sh.queue, sh.tickets, sh.head, sh.tail, NUMPART))
1172 {
1173 warp_shared_state = 100;
1174 break;
1175 }
1176 } while (ns = my_sleep(ns));
1177}

1180template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1181__device__ __forceinline__ void setup_stack_donor_psanse(
1182 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh)
1183{
1184 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
1185 {
1186 size_t Xx_offset = sh.sm_block_id * MAXDEG;
1187 sh.Xx_aux_shared = &gh.Xx_aux[Xx_offset];
1188
1189 size_t clique_offset = sh.sm_block_id * MAXLEVEL;
1190 if (gh.eval) sh.c = &gh.C[clique_offset];
1191
1192 uint32_t *message = &gh.global_message[sh.sm_block_id * MSGCNT];
1193 sh.root_sm_block_id = message[0];
1194 sh.l = sh.base_l = message[1];
1195 sh.srcLen = message[2];
1196 sh.usrcLen = message[3];
1197 sh.i = message[4];
1198 sh.src = sh.i;
1199
1200 auto encode_offset = sh.root_sm_block_id * (MAXDEG * NUMDIVS);
1201 sh.encode = &gh.encoded_induced_subgraph[encode_offset];
1202
1203 size_t ordering_offset = sh.root_sm_block_id * MAXDEG;
1204 if (gh.eval) sh.ordering = &gh.ordering[ordering_offset];
1205
1206 auto level_offset = sh.sm_block_id * NUMDIVS * MAXLEVEL;
1207 sh.pl = &gh.P[level_offset];
1208 sh.bl = &gh.B[level_offset];
1209 sh.al = &gh.A[level_offset];
1210 //sh.Iset = &gh.Iset[level_offset];
1211
1212 auto level_item_offset = sh.sm_block_id * MAXLEVEL;
1213 sh.level_pointer_index = &gh.level_pointer[level_item_offset];
1214 sh.level_pointer_index[current_level] = 0;
1215
1216 sh.colored = &gh.colored[level_item_offset];
1217 sh.colored[current_level] = false;
1218
1219 sh.num_divs_local = (sh.usrcLen + 32 - 1) / 32;
1220 sh.lastMask_i = sh.usrcLen >> 5;
1221 sh.lastMask_ii = (1 << (sh.usrcLen & 0x1F)) - 1;
1222
1223 }
1224 __syncthreads();
1225}

1515template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X>
1516__device__ __forceinline__ bool empty(LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh, const T const* set, const T size)
1517{
1518 unsigned _not_empty = 0;
1519 __shared__ unsigned not_empty;
1520
1521 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
1522 not_empty = 0;
1523
1524 __syncthreads();
1525
1526 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < size; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
1527 _not_empty |= bool(set[j] != 0);
1528
1529 __syncthreads();
1530
1531 const unsigned not_empty_reduced = __any_sync(lh.partMask, _not_empty);
1532
1533 if (lh.lx == 0) atomicOr(&not_empty, not_empty_reduced);
1534
1535 __syncthreads();
1536 return !not_empty;
1537}
1538
1539template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1540__device__ __forceinline__ bool empty_w(LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh, const T const* set, const T size)
1541{
1542 unsigned not_empty = 0;
1543
1544 for (T j = laneIdx; j < size; j += CPARTSIZE)
1545 not_empty |= bool(set[j] != 0);
1546
1547 return !__any_sync(lh.partMask, not_empty);
1548}

1550template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1551__device__ __forceinline__ T popc(LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh, const T const* set, const T size)
1552{
1553 T thread_count = 0;
1554 __shared__ T total_count;
1555
1556 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
1557 total_count = 0;
1558
1559 __syncthreads();
1560
1561 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < size; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
1562 thread_count += __popc(set[j]);
1563
1564 __syncthreads();
1565
1566 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, thread_count);
1567
1568 __syncthreads();
1569
1570 if (lh.lx == 0 && thread_count > 0)
1571 atomicAdd(&total_count, thread_count);
1572
1573 __syncthreads();
1574 return total_count;
1575}

1577
1578template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1579__device__ __forceinline__ bool get_next_candidate_to_color(
1580 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1581 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1582 const T &lim, const int& last_choosen_index, const T const*col)
1583{
1584 if (last_choosen_index >= lim)
1585 {
1586 __syncthreads();
1587 return false;
1588 }
1589 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
1590 lh.colMaskBlock = last_choosen_index >> 5;
1591 lh.colMaskIndex = ~((1 << (last_choosen_index & 0x1F)) - 1);
1592 lh.colNewIndex = __ffs(col[lh.colMaskBlock] & lh.colMaskIndex);
1593 // while there are no bits set to 1
1594 while (lh.colNewIndex == 0)
1595 {
1596 lh.colMaskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1597 ++lh.colMaskBlock;
1598 if ((lh.colMaskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1599 break;
1600 lh.colNewIndex = __ffs(col[lh.colMaskBlock] & lh.colMaskIndex);
1601 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
1602 // If there are no other candidates
1603 if ((lh.colMaskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1604 {
1605 __syncthreads();
1606 return false;
1607 }
1608 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
1609 lh.colNewIndex = (lh.colMaskBlock << 5) + lh.colNewIndex - 1;
1610 __syncthreads();
1611 return true;
1612}

1651template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1652__device__ __forceinline__ bool get_next_candidate_to_color_reverse(
1653 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1654 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1655 const int &lim, const int& last_choosen_index, const T const*col)
1656{
1657 if (last_choosen_index < 0)
1658 {
1659 __syncthreads();
1660 return false;
1661 }
1662 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
1663 lh.colMaskBlock = last_choosen_index >> 5;
1664 lh.colMaskIndex = ((1 << ((last_choosen_index + 1) & 0x1F)) - 1);
1665 lh.colNewIndex = __clz(col[lh.colMaskBlock] & lh.colMaskIndex);
1666 // while there are no bits set to 1
1667 while (lh.colNewIndex == 32)
1668 {
1669 lh.colMaskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1670 --lh.colMaskBlock;
1671 if ((lh.colMaskBlock) < 0)
1672 break;
1673 lh.colNewIndex = __clz(col[lh.colMaskBlock] & lh.colMaskIndex);
1674 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
1675 // If there are no other candidates
1676 if ((lh.colMaskBlock) < 0)
1677 {
1678 __syncthreads();
1679 return false;
1680 }
1681 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
1682 lh.colNewIndex = (lh.colMaskBlock << 5) + (32 - lh.colNewIndex) - 1;
1683 __syncthreads();
1684 return true;
1685}

1688template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1689__device__ __forceinline__ bool get_next_candidate(
1690 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1691 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1692 const T &lim, const T &level_pointer_index, T *cur_pl)
1693{
1694 if (level_pointer_index >= lim)
1695 {
1696 __syncthreads();
1697 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
1698 --sh.l;
1699 __syncthreads();
1700 return false;
1701 }
1702 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
1703 lh.maskBlock = level_pointer_index >> 5;
1704 lh.maskIndex = ~((1 << (level_pointer_index & 0x1F)) - 1);
1705 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_pl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1706 // while there are no bits set to 1
1707 while (lh.newIndex == 0)
1708 {
1709 lh.maskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1710 ++lh.maskBlock;
1711 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1712 break;
1713 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_pl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1714 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
1715 // If there are no other candidates
1716 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1717 {
1718 __syncthreads();
1719 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
1720 --sh.l; // Back to the previous level
1721 __syncthreads();
1722 return false;
1723 }
1724 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
1725 lh.newIndex = (lh.maskBlock << 5) + lh.newIndex - 1;
1726 lh.sameBlockMask = (~((1 << (lh.newIndex & 0x1F)) - 1)) | ~cur_pl[lh.maskBlock];
1727 __syncthreads();
1728 return true;
1729}
1730
1731template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1732__device__ __forceinline__ bool p_maximality(
1733 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh,
1734 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1735 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh)
1736{
1737 // if P == 0
1738 if (mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.pl + current_level * sh.num_divs_local, sh.num_divs_local)) {
1739
1740 __syncthreads();
1741 if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
1742
1743 int old = atomicMax((int*)gh.Cmax_size, sh.l - 1);
1744 if (sh.l - 1 == (*gh.Cmax_size) && sh.l - 1 > old)
1745 printf("Found clique of size %d.\n", sh.l - 1);
1746 --sh.l;
1747 }
1748 __syncthreads();
1749 return true;
1750 }
1751 __syncthreads();
1752 return false;
1753}

1755template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1756__device__ __forceinline__ bool p_maximality_eval(
1757 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh,
1758 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1759 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh)
1760{
1761 // if P == 0
1762 if (mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.pl + current_level * sh.num_divs_local, sh.num_divs_local)) {
1763
1764 if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
1765
1766 // to avoid acquiring the semaphore repeatly
1767 if ((*gh.Cmax_size) < sh.l - 1)
1768 {
1769 gh.max_clique_sem->acquire();
1770
1771 // once acquired check if actually bigger
1772 if ((*gh.Cmax_size) < sh.l - 1)
1773 {
1774 printf("Found clique of size %d.\n", sh.l - 1);
1775 (*gh.Cmax_size) = sh.l - 1;
1776
1777 // save clique
1778 for (T j = 0; j < sh.l - 1; j++)
1779 gh.Cmax[j] = sh.c[j];
1780 }
1781 gh.max_clique_sem->release();
1782 }
1783
1784 --sh.l;
1785 }
1786 __syncthreads();
1787 return true;
1788 }
1789 __syncthreads();
1790 return false;
1791}

1867{

1871 cur_bl[j] = sh.to_bl[j] & m;
1872 cur_al[j] = (cur_pl[j] & ~(sh.to_bl[j])) & m;
1873 }
1874 __syncthreads();
1875}

1903template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1904__device__ __forceinline__ bool bitset_scan(
1905 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1906 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1907 const T& level_pointer_index, const T &lim, const T const* cur_bl)
1908{
1909 // in case not work reverse
1910 // REDO
1911 if (level_pointer_index >= lim)
1912 {
1913 lh.newIndex = lim;
1914 __syncthreads();
1915 return false;
1916 }
1917 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
1918 lh.maskBlock = level_pointer_index >> 5;
1919 lh.maskIndex = ~((1 << (level_pointer_index & 0x1F)) - 1);
1920 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1921
1922 // while there are no bits set to 1
1923 while (lh.newIndex == 0)
1924 {
1925 lh.maskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1926 ++lh.maskBlock;
1927 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1928 break;
1929 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1930 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
1931 // If there are no other candidates
1932 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
1933 {
1934 lh.newIndex = lim;
1935 __syncthreads();
1936 return false;
1937 }
1938 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
1939 lh.newIndex = (lh.maskBlock << 5) + lh.newIndex - 1;
1940
1941 __syncthreads();
1942 return true;
1943}
1944
1945
1946template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1947__device__ __forceinline__ bool bitset_scan_reverse(
1948 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1949 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1950 const int& level_pointer_index, const T &lim, const T const* cur_bl)
1951{
1952 // in case not work reverse
1953 // REDO
1954 if (level_pointer_index <= lim)
1955 {
1956 lh.newIndex = lim;
1957 __syncthreads();
1958 return false;
1959 }
1960 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
1961 lh.maskBlock = level_pointer_index >> 5;
1962 lh.maskIndex = ((1 << ((level_pointer_index + 1) & 0x1F)) - 1);
1963 lh.newIndex = __clz(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1964
1965 // while there are no bits set to 1
1966 while (lh.newIndex == 32)
1967 {
1968 lh.maskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1969 --lh.maskBlock;
1970 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) <= lim)
1971 break;
1972 lh.newIndex = __clz(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
1973 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
1974 // If there are no other candidates
1975 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) <= lim)
1976 {
1977 lh.newIndex = lim;
1978 __syncthreads();
1979 return false;
1980 }
1981 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
1982 lh.newIndex = (lh.maskBlock << 5) + (32 - lh.newIndex) - 1;
1983
1984 __syncthreads();
1985 return true;
1986}

1989template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
1990__device__ __forceinline__ bool get_next_branching_index(
1991 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
1992 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
1993 const T& level_pointer_index, const T &lim, const T const* cur_bl)
1994{
1995 // in case not work reverse
1996 // REDO
1997 if (level_pointer_index >= lim)
1998 {
1999 __syncthreads();
2000 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2001 --sh.l;
2002 __syncthreads();
2003 return false;
2004 }
2005 // Starts from maskblock based on previous vertex index
2006 lh.maskBlock = level_pointer_index >> 5;
2007 lh.maskIndex = ~((1 << (level_pointer_index & 0x1F)) - 1);
2008 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
2009
2010 // while there are no bits set to 1
2011 while (lh.newIndex == 0)
2012 {
2013 lh.maskIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF;
2014 ++lh.maskBlock;
2015 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
2016 break;
2017 lh.newIndex = __ffs(cur_bl[lh.maskBlock] & lh.maskIndex);
2018 } // Counts in maskBlock the number of blocks set to 0
2019 // If there are no other candidates
2020 if ((lh.maskBlock << 5) >= lim)
2021 {
2022 __syncthreads();
2023 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2024 --sh.l; // Back to the previous level
2025 __syncthreads();
2026 return false;
2027 }
2028 // newIndex contains the actual candidate
2029 lh.newIndex = (lh.maskBlock << 5) + lh.newIndex - 1;
2030
2031 __syncthreads();
2032 return true;
2033}

2082
2083template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
2084__device__ __forceinline__ bool reduce(
2085 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
2086 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
2087 const T& num_divs_local, const int level,
2088 T * cur_pl
2089 )
2090{
2091 // Compute degrees
2092 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2093 {
2094 sh.to_bl[j] = cur_pl[j];
2095 }
2096
2097 __shared__ int mod_R;
2098 __shared__ T min_degree;
2099 __shared__ T k;
2100
2101 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2102 {
2103 mod_R = 0;
2104 min_degree = sh.usrcLen;
2105 k = (T)(*gh.Cmax_size) >= level ? (T)(*gh.Cmax_size) - level : 0;
2106 }
2107
2108 __syncthreads();
2109
2110 if (k <= 2) return false;
2111
2112 __syncthreads();
2113
2114 //////////////// Compute degrees /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
2115
2116 for (T block_idx = lh.wx; block_idx < num_divs_local; block_idx += lh.numPartitions)
2117 {
2118 T idx_block = 0;
2119 T block = sh.to_bl[block_idx];
2120 while ((idx_block = __ffs(block)) != 0)
2121 {
2122 T idx_degree = 0;
2123 const T idx = (block_idx << 5) + idx_block - 1;
2124
2125 for (T j = lh.lx; j < num_divs_local; j += CPARTSIZE)
2126 if (sh.to_bl[j] != 0) idx_degree += __popc(sh.to_bl[j] & sh.encode[idx * num_divs_local + j]);
2127
2128 __syncwarp();
2129
2130 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, idx_degree);
2131
2132 __syncwarp();
2133
2134 if (lh.lx == 0)
2135 {
2136 sh.degree[idx] = idx_degree;
2137 atomicAdd(&mod_R, 1);
2138 atomicMin(&min_degree, idx_degree);
2139 }
2140
2141 __syncwarp();
2142
2143 block ^= 1 << (idx_block - 1);
2144
2145 __syncwarp();
2146 }
2147 __syncwarp();
2148 }
2149
2150 __syncthreads();
2151
2152
2153
2154 if (min_degree == mod_R - 1)
2155 {
2156 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2157 {
2158 const T old = atomicMax((uint32_t*)gh.Cmax_size, sh.l + mod_R - 1);
2159 if (old < sh.l + mod_R - 1)
2160 printf("Reduce finds clique of size %u.\n", *(gh.Cmax_size));
2161 sh.l--;
2162 }
2163 __syncthreads();
2164 return true;
2165 }
2166
2167 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
2168
2169 __syncthreads();
2170
2171 for (T idx = threadIdx.x; idx < sh.usrcLen; idx += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2172 {
2173 const T li = idx >> 5;
2174 const T ri = 1 << (idx & 0x1F);
2175 if ((sh.to_bl[li] & ri) > 0)
2176 {
2177 if (sh.degree[idx] == 0)
2178 {
2179 atomicXor(&sh.to_bl[li], ri);
2180 atomicSub(&mod_R, 1);
2181 }
2182 }
2183 }
2184
2185 __syncthreads();
2186
2187 // Reduce
2188 while (true)
2189 {
2190 __shared__ int preSize;
2191
2192 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2193 preSize = mod_R;
2194
2195 __syncthreads();
2196
2197 // for each index of R
2198 for (T idx = 0; idx < sh.usrcLen; idx++)
2199 {
2200
2201 const T block_idx = idx >> 5;
2202 const T ri_idx = 1 << (idx & 0x1F);
2203 if ((sh.to_bl[block_idx] & ri_idx) > 0)
2204 {
2205 __syncthreads();
2206 if (sh.degree[idx] < k - 1 || sh.degree[idx] >= mod_R - 4)
2207 {
2208 bool rule_1 = sh.degree[idx] < k - 1;
2209 __syncthreads();
2210 if (rule_1)
2211 {
2212 // remove u from G
2213 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2214 {
2215 //printf ("Rule 1 applyied\n");
2216 sh.to_bl[block_idx] ^= ri_idx;
2217 mod_R--;
2218 }
2219
2220 __syncthreads();
2221
2222 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2223 {
2224 T neighbour_block = sh.to_bl[j] & sh.encode[idx * num_divs_local + j];
2225 T neighbour_block_idx = 0;
2226 while ((neighbour_block_idx = __ffs(neighbour_block)) != 0)
2227 {
2228 const T neighbour_idx = (j << 5) + neighbour_block_idx - 1;
2229 sh.degree[neighbour_idx]--;
2230 const T neighbour_block_bit = 1 << (neighbour_block_idx - 1);
2231 if (sh.degree[neighbour_idx] == 0) {
2232 sh.to_bl[j] ^= neighbour_block_bit;
2233 atomicSub(&mod_R, 1);
2234 }
2235 neighbour_block ^= neighbour_block_bit;
2236 }
2237 }
2238
2239 __syncthreads();
2240 continue;
2241
2242 }
2243
2244 bool rule_2 = sh.degree[idx] == mod_R - 2;
2245 if (!rule_1 && rule_2)
2246 {
2247 __shared__ T u;
2248 __shared__ T not_neighbours;
2249 __shared__ T not_neighbours_count;
2250
2251 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2252 {
2253 u = sh.usrcLen;
2254 not_neighbours_count = 0;
2255 }
2256
2257 __syncthreads();
2258
2259 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2260 {
2261 T block_of_idx = block_idx == j ? ri_idx : 0x00000000;
2262 T last_mask = j == sh.lastMask_i ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
2263 T lone_vertex_block = (sh.to_bl[j] & ~(sh.encode[idx * num_divs_local + j] | block_of_idx)) & last_mask;
2264 T lone_vertex_idx_block = 0;
2265 while((lone_vertex_idx_block = __ffs(lone_vertex_block)) != 0)
2266 {
2267 const T count = atomicAdd(&not_neighbours_count, 1);
2268 if (count == 0) not_neighbours = (j << 5) + lone_vertex_idx_block - 1;
2269 lone_vertex_block ^= 1 << (lone_vertex_idx_block - 1);
2270 }
2271 }
2272
2273 __syncthreads();
2274
2275 if (not_neighbours_count == 1) {
2276
2277 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2278 {
2279 //printf("Rule 2 applyied\n");
2280 u = not_neighbours;
2281 }
2282 __syncthreads();
2283
2284 // Remove u from R
2285 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2286 {
2287 const T li_u = u >> 5;
2288 const T ri_u = 1 << (u & 0x1F);
2289 sh.to_bl[li_u] ^= ri_u;
2290 mod_R--;
2291 }
2292
2293 __syncthreads();
2294
2295 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2296 {
2297 T neighbour_block = sh.to_bl[j] & sh.encode[u * num_divs_local + j];
2298 T neighbour_block_idx = 0;
2299 while ((neighbour_block_idx = __ffs(neighbour_block)) != 0)
2300 {
2301 const T neighbour_idx = (j << 5) + neighbour_block_idx - 1;
2302 sh.degree[neighbour_idx]--;
2303 const T neighbour_block_bit = 1 << (neighbour_block_idx - 1);
2304 if (sh.degree[neighbour_idx] == 0) {
2305 sh.to_bl[j] ^= neighbour_block_bit;
2306 atomicSub(&mod_R, 1);
2307 }
2308 neighbour_block ^= neighbour_block_bit;
2309 }
2310 }
2311
2312 }
2313
2314 __syncthreads();
2315 continue;
2316 }
2317
2318 bool rule_3 = sh.degree[idx] == mod_R - 3;
2319 if (!rule_1 && rule_3)
2320 {
2321 __shared__ T u1, u2;
2322 __shared__ T not_neighbours[2];
2323 __shared__ T not_neighbours_count;
2324
2325 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2326 {
2327 u1 = sh.usrcLen;
2328 u2 = sh.usrcLen;
2329 not_neighbours_count = 0;
2330 }
2331
2332 __syncthreads();
2333
2334 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
2335 {
2336 const T block_of_idx = block_idx == j ? ri_idx : 0x00000000;
2337 const T last_mask = j == sh.lastMask_i ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
2338 T lone_vertex_block = (sh.to_bl[j] & ~(sh.encode[idx * num_divs_local + j] | block_of_idx)) & last_mask;
2339 T lone_vertex_idx_block = 0;
2340 while ((lone_vertex_idx_block = __ffs(lone_vertex_block)) != 0)
2341 {
2342 const T count = atomicAdd(&not_neighbours_count, 1);
2343 if (count < 2)
2344 not_neighbours[count] = (j << 5) + lone_vertex_idx_block - 1;
2345
2346 lone_vertex_block ^= 1 << (lone_vertex_idx_block - 1);
2347 }
2348 }
2349
2350 __syncthreads();
2351
2352 if (not_neighbours_count == 2) {
2353
2354 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2355 {
2356 u1 = not_neighbours[0];
2357 u2 = not_neighbours[1];
2358 }
2359
2360 __syncthreads();
2361
2362 // Remove u from g
2363 const T li_u1 = u1 >> 5;
2364 const T ri_u1 = 1 << (u1 & 0x1F);
2365 const T li_u2 = u2 >> 5;
2366 const T ri_u2 = 1 << (u2 & 0x1F);
2367
2368 const bool u1_u2 = (sh.encode[u1 * num_divs_local + li_u2] & ri_u2) > 0;
2369
2370 if (!u1_u2)
2371 {
2372 //if (threadIdx.x == 0) printf("Rule 3 applyied.\n");
2373
2374 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
2375 {
2376 sh.to_bl[li_u1] ^= ri_u1;
2377 sh.to_bl[li_u2] ^= ri_u2;
2378 mod_R -= 2;
2379 }
2380

2959template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
2960__device__ __forceinline__ bool reduce_second_level(

2962 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
2963 const T& num_divs_local, const int level
2964 )
2965{
2966 __shared__ T mod_R;

2968 __shared__ T k;

2971 {
2972 mod_R = 0;

3556
3557template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
3558__device__ __forceinline__ bool warp_reduce(
3559 GLOBAL_HANDLE<T> &gh, LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
3560 WARP_SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &wsh,
3561 const T& num_divs_local, const int level,
3562 T * cur_pl
3563 )
3564{
3565 // Compute degrees
3566 for (T j = laneIdx; j < num_divs_local; j += CPARTSIZE)
3567 {
3568 wsh.to_col[j] = cur_pl[j];
3569 }
3570
3571 __shared__ T __warp__(mod_R);
3572 __shared__ T __warp__(min_degree);
3573 __shared__ T __warp__(k);
3574
3575 if (laneIdx == 0)
3576 {
3577 mod_R[warpIdx] = 0;
3578 min_degree[warpIdx] = wsh.usrcLen;
3579 k[warpIdx] = (T)(*gh.Cmax_size) >= level ? (T)(*gh.Cmax_size) - level : 0;
3580 }
3581
3582 __syncwarp();
3583
3584 if (k[warpIdx] <= 2) return false;
3585
3586 __syncwarp();
3587
3588 //////////////// Compute degrees /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
3589
3590 for (T block_idx = 0; block_idx < num_divs_local; block_idx++)
3591 {
3592 T idx_block = 0;
3593 T block = wsh.to_col[block_idx];
3594 while ((idx_block = __ffs(block)) != 0)
3595 {
3596 T idx_degree = 0;
3597 T idx = (block_idx << 5) + idx_block - 1;
3598 for (T j = lh.lx; j < num_divs_local; j += CPARTSIZE)
3599 idx_degree += __popc(wsh.to_col[j] & wsh.encode[idx * num_divs_local + j]);
3600
3601 __syncwarp();
3602
3603 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, idx_degree);
3604
3605 __syncwarp();
3606
3607 if (lh.lx == 0)
3608 {
3609 wsh.degree[idx] = idx_degree;
3610 mod_R[warpIdx]++;
3611 min_degree[warpIdx] = min(min_degree[warpIdx], idx_degree);
3612 }
3613 __syncwarp();
3614
3615 block ^= 1 << (idx_block - 1);
3616
3617 __syncwarp();
3618 }
3619 __syncwarp();
3620 }
3621
3622 __syncwarp();
3623 if (min_degree[warpIdx] == mod_R[warpIdx] - 1)
3624 {
3625 if (laneIdx == 0)
3626 {
3627 const T old = atomicMax((uint32_t*)gh.Cmax_size, wsh.l + mod_R[warpIdx] - 1);
3628 if (old < wsh.l + mod_R[warpIdx] - 1)
3629 printf("Reduce finds clique of size %u.\n", *(gh.Cmax_size));
3630 wsh.l--;
3631 }
3632 __syncwarp();
3633 return true;
3634 }
3635
3636 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
3637
3638 __syncwarp();
3639
3640 for (T idx = laneIdx; idx < wsh.usrcLen; idx += CPARTSIZE)
3641 {
3642 const T li = idx >> 5;

4157
4158template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4159__device__ __forceinline__ int compute_upperbound_chromatic_number_psanse(
4160 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4161 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const int ub,
4162 const T& num_divs_local
4163 )
4164{
4165 __shared__ int color;
4166 __shared__ T pointer;
4167
4168 fetch(color, 1);
4169
4170 __syncthreads();
4171
4172 // UNCOL = P
4173 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4174 {
4175 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
4176 sh.to_bl[j] = m;
4177 }
4178
4179 __syncthreads();
4180
4181 while(color <= ub && !mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local))
4182 {
4183
4184 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4185 sh.to_col[j] = sh.to_bl[j];
4186
4187 __syncthreads();
4188
4189 fetch(pointer, 0);
4190
4191 __syncthreads();
4192
4193 // get one vertex
4194 while (mcp::get_next_candidate_to_color(lh, sh, sh.usrcLen, pointer, sh.to_col))
4195 {
4196 // remove adjacet from color
4197 // if (threadIdx.x == 0 && sh.i == 0)
4198 // printf("cand :%u\n", lh.colNewIndex);
4199
4200 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (lh.colNewIndex >> 5); j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4201 {
4202 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
4203 sh.to_col[j] &= ~(sh.encode[lh.colNewIndex * num_divs_local + j]) & m;
4204 }
4205
4206 __syncthreads();
4207
4208 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4209 {
4210 pointer = lh.colNewIndex + 1;
4211 const T li = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
4212 const T ri = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
4213 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
4214 //sh.Iset[color * num_divs_local + li] |= ri;
4215 }
4216
4217 __syncthreads();
4218 }
4219
4220 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4221 color++;
4222
4223 __syncthreads();
4224
4225 }
4226
4227 __syncthreads();
4228
4229 if (mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local))
4230 {
4231 __syncthreads();
4232 return ub;
4233 }
4234
4235 __syncthreads();
4236 return color;
4237
4238}

4240template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4241__device__ __forceinline__ int add_to_iset_tomita(
4242 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4243 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
4244 const int& index, int& k, const int& ub,

4246{
4247
4248 __shared__ bool inserted;
4249
4250 if (threadIdx.x == 0) inserted = false;
4251
4252 __syncthreads();
4253
4254 // If is it possible to insert into an existing iset
4255
4256 for (T k_j = 0; k_j < k; k_j++)
4257 {
4258 __shared__ unsigned not_empty_intersect;
4259 if (threadIdx.x == 0) not_empty_intersect = 0;
4260 __syncthreads();
4261
4262 unsigned local_not_empty_intersect = 0;
4263 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.Iset_count[k_j]; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4264 {
4265 const T index_of_iset = sh.Iset[k_j * MAXDEG + j];
4266 const T index_li = index_of_iset >> 5;
4267 const T index_ri = 1 << (index_of_iset & 0x1F);
4268 local_not_empty_intersect += (sh.encode[index * num_divs_local + index_li] & index_ri) > 0 ? 1 : 0;
4269 }
4270
4271 __syncthreads();
4272
4273 const unsigned local_not_empty_intersect_mask = __any_sync(lh.partMask, local_not_empty_intersect);
4274
4275 __syncthreads();
4276
4277 if (lh.lx == 0 && local_not_empty_intersect_mask != 0)
4278 {
4279 atomicOr(&not_empty_intersect, local_not_empty_intersect_mask);
4280 }
4281
4282 __syncthreads();
4283
4284 if (!not_empty_intersect)
4285 {
4286 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4287 {
4288 const T li = index >> 5;
4289 const T ri = 1 << (index & 0x1F);
4290 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
4291 sh.Iset[k_j * MAXDEG + sh.Iset_count[k_j]++] = index;
4292 inserted = true;
4293 }
4294
4295 __syncthreads();
4296 break;
4297 }
4298
4299 __syncthreads();
4300 }
4301
4302 __syncthreads();
4303
4304 const bool create_iset = !inserted && k < ub;
4305 __syncthreads();
4306 if (threadIdx.x == 0 && create_iset) // Create a new Iset
4307 {
4308 const T li = index >> 5;
4309 const T ri = 1 << (index & 0x1F);
4310 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
4311 sh.Iset_count[k] = 0;
4312 sh.Iset[k * MAXDEG + sh.Iset_count[k]++] = index;
4313 inserted = true;
4314 k++;
4315 }
4316
4317 __syncthreads();
4318 return inserted;
4319}

4322template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4323__device__ __forceinline__ int compute_upperbound_chromatic_number_tomita(
4324 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4325 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const int ub,
4326 const T& num_divs_local
4327 )
4328{
4329 __shared__ int k;
4330 __shared__ int index;
4331
4332 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4333 {
4334 k = 0;
4335 index = 0;
4336 }
4337
4338 __syncthreads();
4339
4340 // Reset
4341 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4342 {
4343 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
4344 sh.to_bl[j] = m;
4345 }
4346
4347 __syncthreads();
4348
4349 while(index < sh.usrcLen && add_to_iset_tomita(lh, sh, index, k, ub, sh.num_divs_local))
4350 {
4351 if (threadIdx.x == 0) index++;
4352 __syncthreads();
4353 }
4354
4355 __syncthreads();
4356
4357 if (mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local))
4358 {
4359 __syncthreads();
4360 return ub;
4361 }
4362
4363 __syncthreads();
4364 return k + 1;
4365

4368template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4369__device__ __forceinline__ int try_to_renumber(
4370 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4371 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh,
4372 const int& index, const int k, const int& ub,
4373 const T& num_divs_local
4374 )
4375{
4376 __shared__ int total_neighbours;
4377 __shared__ bool inserted;
4378
4379 if (threadIdx.x == 0) inserted = false;
4380
4381 __syncthreads();
4382
4383 for (T iset_i = 0; iset_i < (ub - 1) && !inserted; iset_i++)
4384 {
4385 // Intersect
4386 if (threadIdx.x == 0) total_neighbours = 0;
4387 __syncthreads();
4388
4389 unsigned neighbours = 0;
4390 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.Iset_count[iset_i]; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4391 {
4392 const T index_of_iset = sh.Iset[iset_i * MAXDEG + j];
4393 const T index_li = index_of_iset >> 5;
4394 const T index_ri = 1 << (index_of_iset & 0x1F);
4395 neighbours += (sh.encode[index * num_divs_local + index_li] & index_ri) > 0 ? 1 : 0;
4396 }
4397
4398 __syncthreads();
4399
4400 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, neighbours);
4401
4402 __syncthreads();
4403
4404 if (lh.lx == 0 && neighbours > 0)
4405 {
4406 atomicAdd(&total_neighbours, neighbours);
4407 }
4408
4409 __syncthreads();
4410
4411 if (total_neighbours == 1)
4412 {
4413
4414 __shared__ T one_neighbour;
4415 __shared__ T one_neighbour_pos;
4416
4417 // Get one neighbour
4418 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.Iset_count[iset_i]; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4419 {
4420 const T index_of_iset = sh.Iset[iset_i * MAXDEG + j];
4421 const T index_li = index_of_iset >> 5;
4422 const T index_ri = 1 << (index_of_iset & 0x1F);
4423 if ((sh.encode[index * num_divs_local + index_li] & index_ri) > 0)
4424 {one_neighbour = index_of_iset; one_neighbour_pos = j;}
4425 }
4426
4427 for (T iset_j = iset_i + 1; iset_j < ub && !inserted; iset_j++)
4428 {
4429 __shared__ unsigned not_empty_intersect_;
4430 if (threadIdx.x == 0) not_empty_intersect_ = 0;
4431 __syncthreads();
4432
4433 unsigned local_not_empty_intersect_ = 0;
4434 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < sh.Iset_count[iset_j]; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4435 {
4436 const T index_of_iset = sh.Iset[iset_j * MAXDEG + j];
4437 const T index_li = index_of_iset >> 5;
4438 const T index_ri = 1 << (index_of_iset & 0x1F);
4439 local_not_empty_intersect_ += (sh.encode[one_neighbour * num_divs_local + index_li] & index_ri) > 0 ? 1 : 0;
4440 }
4441
4442 __syncthreads();
4443
4444 const unsigned local_not_empty_intersect_mask_ = __any_sync(lh.partMask, local_not_empty_intersect_);
4445
4446 __syncthreads();
4447
4448 if (lh.lx == 0 && local_not_empty_intersect_mask_ != 0)
4449 {
4450 atomicOr(&not_empty_intersect_, local_not_empty_intersect_mask_);
4451 }
4452
4453 __syncthreads();
4454
4455 // iset found
4456 if (!not_empty_intersect_)
4457 {
4458 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4459 {
4460 const T li_i = index >> 5;
4461 const T ri_i = 1 << (index & 0x1F);
4462 // const T li_j = one_neighbour >> 5;
4463 // const T ri_j = 1 << (one_neighbour & 0x1F);
4464 sh.Iset[iset_i * MAXDEG + one_neighbour_pos] = index;
4465 sh.Iset[iset_j * MAXDEG + sh.Iset_count[iset_j]++] = one_neighbour;
4466 sh.to_bl[li_i] ^= ri_i;
4467 inserted = true;
4468 }
4469 __syncthreads();
4470 }
4471
4472 __syncthreads();
4473 }
4474 }
4475 }
4476
4477 __syncthreads();
4478 return inserted;
4479}

4482template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4483__device__ __forceinline__ int compute_upperbound_chromatic_number_tomita_renumber(
4484 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4485 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const int ub,
4486 const T& num_divs_local
4487 )
4488{
4489 __shared__ int k;
4490 __shared__ int index;

4493 if (threadIdx.x == 0)

4528 index++;
4529
4530 __syncthreads();
4531 }
4532
4533 __syncthreads();
4534
4535 if (mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local))
4536 {
4537 __syncthreads();
4538 return ub;
4539 }
4540
4541 __syncthreads();

4547template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
4548__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_branches_fast_recolor(
4549 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
4550 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const int ub,
4551 const T& num_divs_local, const T *const cur_pl
4552 )
4553{
4554 __shared__ int color;
4555 __shared__ T pointer;
4556 //__shared__ T to_uncol[MAX_DEGEN / 32];
4557 //__shared__ T to_iset[MAX_DEGEN / 32];
4558
4559 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4560 {
4561 color = 0;
4562 }
4563 __syncthreads();
4564
4565 // UNCOL = P
4566 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4567 {
4568 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
4569 sh.to_bl[j] = cur_pl[j] & m;
4570 //to_uncol[j] = sh.to_bl[j];
4571 }
4572
4573 __syncthreads();
4574
4575 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4576 sh.to_col[j] = sh.to_bl[j];
4577
4578 __syncthreads();
4579
4580 while(ub > 0 && color <= ub /* && !mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local)*/)
4581 {
4582
4583 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4584 pointer = 0;
4585
4586 __syncthreads();
4587
4588 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4589 {
4590 sh.Iset[color * num_divs_local + j] = 0x00;
4591 }
4592
4593 __syncthreads();
4594
4595 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4596 {
4597 sh.min_bounds(color) = sh.usrcLen;
4598 sh.max_bounds(color) = 0;
4599 }
4600
4601 __syncthreads();
4602
4603 // get one vertex
4604
4605 while (mcp::get_next_candidate_to_color(lh, sh, sh.usrcLen, pointer, sh.to_col))
4606 {
4607
4608 __shared__ bool recolored;
4609
4610 if (threadIdx.x == 0) recolored = false;
4611
4612 __syncthreads();
4613
4614 if (color >= ub && ub >= 3 /*&& popc<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE>(lh, sh.to_col, num_divs_local) == 1*/)
4615 {
4616 ////////////// Re-Color ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
4617
4618 // Save in shared
4619 __shared__ T to_color_idx_neighbourhood[MAX_DEGEN / 32];
4620
4621 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4622 {
4623 to_color_idx_neighbourhood[j] = sh.encode[lh.colNewIndex * num_divs_local + j];
4624 }
4625
4626 for (T iset_i = 0; iset_i < ub - 1 && !recolored; iset_i++)
4627 {
4628
4629 __shared__ T total_neighbours;
4630 T neighbours = 0;
4631 if (threadIdx.x == 0) total_neighbours = 0;
4632
4633 __syncthreads();
4634
4635 __shared__ T one_neighbour;
4636 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (sh.min_bounds(iset_i) >> 5); j < min((sh.max_bounds(iset_i) >> 5) + 1, num_divs_local); j += BLOCK_DIM_X) {
4637 neighbours += __popc(sh.Iset[iset_i * num_divs_local + j] & to_color_idx_neighbourhood[j]);
4638 }
4639
4640 __syncthreads();
4641
4642 reduce_part<T, CPARTSIZE>(lh.partMask, neighbours);
4643
4644 __syncthreads();
4645
4646 if (lh.lx == 0 && neighbours > 0);
4647 atomicAdd(&total_neighbours, neighbours);
4648
4649 __syncthreads();
4650
4651 if (total_neighbours == 0)
4652 {
4653 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4654 {
4655 const T li = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
4656 const T ri = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
4657 sh.min_bounds(iset_i) = min(sh.min_bounds(iset_i), lh.colNewIndex);
4658 sh.max_bounds(iset_i) = max(sh.max_bounds(iset_i), lh.colNewIndex);
4659 sh.Iset[iset_i * num_divs_local + li] |= ri;
4660 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
4661 sh.to_col[li] ^= ri;
4662 recolored = true;
4663 }
4664
4665 __syncthreads();
4666 }
4667 else
4668 if (total_neighbours == 1)
4669 {
4670
4671 // Save in shared
4672 __shared__ T one_neighbour_neighbourhood[MAX_DEGEN / 32];
4673
4674 __shared__ T one_neighbour;
4675 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (sh.min_bounds(iset_i) >> 5); j < min((sh.max_bounds(iset_i) >> 5) + 1, num_divs_local); j += BLOCK_DIM_X) {
4676 const T neigh_block = sh.Iset[iset_i * num_divs_local + j] & to_color_idx_neighbourhood[j];
4677 if (__popc(neigh_block) == 1) one_neighbour = (j << 5) + __ffs(neigh_block) - 1;
4678 }
4679
4680 __syncthreads();
4681
4682 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4683 one_neighbour_neighbourhood[j] = sh.encode[one_neighbour * num_divs_local + j];
4684
4685 __syncthreads();
4686
4687 for (T iset_j = iset_i + 1; iset_j < ub && !recolored; iset_j++)
4688 {
4689
4690 T neighbours_ = 0;
4691 __shared__ T any_neighbours;
4692 if (threadIdx.x == 0) any_neighbours = 0;
4693
4694 __syncthreads();
4695
4696 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (sh.min_bounds(iset_j) >> 5); j < min((sh.max_bounds(iset_j) >> 5) + 1, num_divs_local); j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4697 {
4698 neighbours_ |= sh.Iset[iset_j * num_divs_local + j] & one_neighbour_neighbourhood[j];
4699 }
4700
4701 __syncthreads();
4702
4703 const T any_neighbours_warp = __any_sync(lh.partMask, neighbours_);
4704
4705 __syncthreads();
4706
4707 if (lh.lx == 0 && any_neighbours_warp)
4708 atomicOr(&any_neighbours, any_neighbours_warp);
4709
4710 __syncthreads();
4711
4712 // iset found
4713 if (!any_neighbours)
4714 {
4715 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4716 {
4717 const T li_i = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
4718 const T ri_i = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
4719 const T li_j = one_neighbour >> 5;
4720 const T ri_j = 1 << (one_neighbour & 0x1F);
4721 sh.Iset[iset_i * num_divs_local + li_j] ^= ri_j;
4722 sh.Iset[iset_i * num_divs_local + li_i] |= ri_i;
4723 sh.Iset[iset_j * num_divs_local + li_j] |= ri_j;
4724 sh.min_bounds(iset_i) = min(sh.min_bounds(iset_i), lh.colNewIndex);
4725 sh.max_bounds(iset_i) = max(sh.max_bounds(iset_i), lh.colNewIndex);
4726 sh.min_bounds(iset_j) = min(sh.min_bounds(iset_j), one_neighbour);
4727 sh.max_bounds(iset_j) = max(sh.max_bounds(iset_j), one_neighbour);
4728 sh.to_bl[li_i] ^= ri_i;
4729 sh.to_col[li_i] ^= ri_i;
4730 recolored = true;
4731 }
4732
4733 __syncthreads();
4734 }
4735
4736 __syncthreads();
4737 }
4738
4739 __syncthreads();
4740 }
4741
4742 __syncthreads();
4743 }
4744 //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
4745
4746 } else if (threadIdx.x == 0 && !recolored && color < ub)
4747 {
4748 const T li = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
4749 const T ri = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
4750 sh.min_bounds(color) = min(sh.min_bounds(color), lh.colNewIndex);
4751 sh.max_bounds(color) = max(sh.max_bounds(color), lh.colNewIndex);
4752 sh.Iset[color * num_divs_local + li] |= ri;
4753 }
4754
4755 __syncthreads();
4756
4757 if (!recolored && color < ub)
4758 {
4759
4760 // if (color == ub)
4761 // {
4762 // __syncthreads();
4763 // break;
4764 // }
4765
4766 __syncthreads();
4767
4768 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (lh.colNewIndex >> 5); j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4769 {
4770 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
4771 sh.to_col[j] &= ~(sh.encode[lh.colNewIndex * num_divs_local + j]) & m;
4772 }
4773
4774 __syncthreads();
4775
4776 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
4777 {
4778 const T li = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
4779 const T ri = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
4780 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
4781 sh.to_col[li] ^= ri;
4782 }
4783
4784 __syncthreads();
4785
4786 }
4787
4788 __syncthreads();
4789
4790 if (threadIdx.x == 0) pointer = lh.colNewIndex + 1;
4791
4792 __syncthreads();
4793 }
4794
4795 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
4796 sh.to_col[j] = sh.to_bl[j];
4797
4798 __syncthreads();
4799
4800 if (threadIdx.x == 0) color++;
4801
4802 __syncthreads();
4803
4804 }
4805
4806 if (threadIdx.x == 0) sh.colored[current_level] = true;
4807 __syncthreads();
4808 return;
4809
4810}

5128template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
5129__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_branches_fast(
5130 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
5131 SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &sh, const int r,
5132 const T& num_divs_local, const int level, const T const* cur_pl)
5133{
5134 __shared__ int color;
5135 __shared__ int pointer;
5136
5137 fetch(color, 1);
5138
5139 __syncthreads();
5140
5141 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
5142 sh.to_bl[j] = cur_pl[j];
5143
5144 __syncthreads();
5145
5146 while(color <= r && !mcp::empty<T, BLOCK_DIM_X>(lh, sh.to_bl, num_divs_local))
5147 {
5148
5149 for (T j = threadIdx.x; j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
5150 sh.to_col[j] = sh.to_bl[j];
5151
5152 __syncthreads();
5153
5154 fetch(pointer, 0);
5155
5156 __syncthreads();
5157
5158 // get one vertex
5159 while (mcp::get_next_candidate_to_color(lh, sh, sh.usrcLen, pointer, sh.to_col))
5160 {
5161
5162 for (T j = threadIdx.x + (lh.colNewIndex >> 5); j < num_divs_local; j += BLOCK_DIM_X)
5163 {
5164 const T m = (j == sh.lastMask_i) ? sh.lastMask_ii : 0xFFFFFFFF;
5165 sh.to_col[j] &= ~(sh.encode[lh.colNewIndex * num_divs_local + j]) & m;
5166 }
5167
5168 __syncthreads();
5169
5170 if (threadIdx.x == 0)
5171 {
5172 pointer = lh.colNewIndex + 1;
5173 const T li = lh.colNewIndex >> 5;
5174 const T ri = 1 << (lh.colNewIndex & 0x1F);
5175 sh.to_bl[li] ^= ri;
5176 }
5177
5178 __syncthreads();
5179 }
5180
5181 if (threadIdx.x == 0) color++;
5182 __syncthreads();
5183
5184 }
5185
5186 fetch(sh.colored[level], true);
5187
5188 __syncthreads();
5189 return;
5190}

5255template <typename T, uint BLOCK_DIM_X, uint CPARTSIZE>
5256__device__ __forceinline__ void compute_warp_branches_fast_(
5257 LOCAL_HANDLE<T> &lh,
5258 WARP_SHARED_HANDLE<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE> &wsh, const int r,

5260{
5261 __shared__ int __warp__(color);

5272 __syncwarp();

5275 {

5278 wsh.to_col[j] = cur_bl[j];
5279
5280 __syncwarp();
5281

5283 pointer[warpIdx] = 0;
5284
5285 __syncwarp();
5286
5287 // get one vertex
5288 while (mcp::get_next_warp_candidate_to_color_<T, BLOCK_DIM_X, CPARTSIZE>(lh, wsh.usrcLen, pointer[warpIdx], wsh.to_col))
5289 {

5297 __syncwarp();
5298
5299 if (laneIdx == 0)
5300 {

5313 __syncwarp();
